AN/APG-79(V)4 is a different radar and is not an index name; treating it as a designator variant of APG-73 is exactly the invented-variant error lens B exists to catch. Independently, the buy is a 100% Government of Canada purchase for CF-18A integration, so no U.S. Navy procurement line executes it.

proposals.announcement_evidence: to exercise options for the accomplishment of the planning yard services for the Littoral Combat Ship in-service ships

proposals.announcement_evidence: for USS Pearl Harbor (LSD 52) fiscal 2014 extended dry-dock phased maintenance availability

proposals.announcement_evidence: This modification increases the ceiling of the contract to procure up to 12,000 additional Precision Laser Guidance Sets for the Laser Joint Direct Attack Munition

The item procured - Precision Laser Guidance Sets - is the laser guidance kit that turns a JDAM into an LJDAM, i.e. the line's own end item rather than a platform the contract supports. This is an IDIQ ceiling increase, but it is not the section-3 'IDIQ ceiling with no named program' pattern: the scope names one munition program and one article. Only BLI 0148 owns the LJDAM name in this index, so there is no cross-PE collision.

refute_a.reason: The full paragraph ends 'No funds are being obligated at time of award; funds will be obligated on individual delivery orders as they are issued' - a bare IDIQ ceiling raise that names no appropriation and pays for nothing, so nothing ties the action to ammunition line 0148's account rather than to Air Force JDAM money or FMS orders placed later on the same vehicle.

refute_b.reason: Only BLI 0148 carries the LJDAM name in the index (line 31), and the same line owns DSU-38/40/42 - DSU-38 IS the Precision Laser Guidance Set the announcement buys - so the article as well as the name belongs to 0148; the one other laser row, 'The Laser Guided Training Round (LGTR)' under 0160 Practice Bombs, is a different munition.

proposals.announcement_evidence: to exercise an option for the procurement of 100 Tomahawk Block IV All-Up-Round missiles
proposals.rationale: Tomahawk Block IV is UGM-109E/RGM-109E, and UGM-109E is an index name, but it sits under WPN line 2301 whose title is 'Tomahawk Mods' - a modification line. This award buys 100 new all-up-round missiles, which is new-missile procurement, not modification of fielded rounds; the index carries no Tomahawk new-buy line for this org, and the only other Tomahawk owner (0204229N) is an RDT&E element. The evidence therefore does not establish that this procurement executes the mods line.

proposals.announcement_evidence: to exercise an option for VH-3D/VH-60 Executive Helicopter Special Progressive Aircraft Rework sustainment support services
proposals.rationale: VH-3D is carried verbatim by aircraft-modification line 0566 (Executive Helicopters Series), so the name is genuinely present. But the scope the announcement describes is contractor sustainment support services - 'security, project engineering, integrated logistics support, VIP Helicopter training, and program support' - with no funding obligated at award. That is the O&M-sustainment-attached-to-a-procurement-line failure mode; the aircraft-modification line funds VH-3D/VH-60N airframe modifications, not a services option.

proposals.announcement_evidence: to procure additional Rolling Airframe Missile Block 2B Guided Missile Round Pack and special tooling/test equipment

proposals.announcement_evidence: the production, spares, production support material, engineering support, and hardware repair of components for MK 48 Heavyweight Torpedo All Up Round
proposals.rationale: 'MK 48 Heavyweight Torpedo All Up Round' normalizes to the index name 'MK-48 Torpedo' (hyphen only), which WPN line 3117 owns under the title MK-48 Torpedo. refute_b.reason: The index has three other MK-48 owners - 0205632N 'MK-48 ADCAP' (RDT&E), 3225 'MK-48 Torpedo ADCAP Mods' and 6120 CBASS under Spares and Repair Parts - but the exact string 'MK-48 Torpedo' is owned only by 3117, the stated fiscal 2025 weapons procurement money rules out the RDT&E element, and the article is an All Up Round (a complete torpedo) rather than a mod kit or a spare, which separates it from 3225 and 6120.

proposals.announcement_evidence: to continue performance of the repair, maintenance, upgrades and modernization efforts on the USS Columbus (SSN 762) Engineered Overhaul
proposals.rationale: Name-collision trap, not a link: USS Columbus (SSN 762) is a Los Angeles-class attack submarine and has nothing to do with the COLUMBIA-class SSBN line 1045. proposals.announcement_evidence: for integrated common processors (ICP) on behalf of the Program Executive Office Submarines
proposals.rationale: The announcement names the article by name and acronym ('integrated common processors (ICP)') and then defines it: 'The ICP program provides a common Integrated Undersea Surveillance Systems (IUSS) signal processing and display system software and hardware suite for Surveillance Towed Array Sensor System ships and IUSS shore sites.' refute_b.reason: 'Integrated Common Processor' is owned by 0204311N alone; the only other ICP in the index (0604269N, line 894) expands to EA-18G 'Integrated Capability Package (ICP-3)', an acronym collision with a different expansion on an aircraft EW line, and the announcement spells the name out and places it under PEO Submarines' IUSS mission, which is 0204311N's own scope. proposals.announcement_evidence: to exercise options for fiscal 2021 for the Rolling Airframe Missile Block 2/2A Guided Missile Round Pack, spare replacement components and recertification
proposals.rationale: 'Rolling Airframe Missile Block 2/2A Guided Missile Round Pack' is the index name 'Rolling Airframe Missile (RAM)' plus a block designator, and WPN line 2242 (title 'Ram') is the RAM buy line. refute_b.reason: There is a genuine exact-name collision - 'Rolling Airframe Missile (RAM)' appears at both 2242 (title 'Ram') and 6120 (title 'Spares and Repair Parts'), and 6120 is NOT caught by the loader's CATCHALL_TITLE regex, so it is a live alternative owner that the announcement's 'spare replacement components' would fit - but the head article of the buy is the Block 2/2A Guided Missile Round Pack, a complete missile round rather than a spare part, which is the named buy line's own end item; the CIWS 'RAM Defense Capability (CRDC)' row at 4205 is a different system.

proposals.announcement_evidence: to exercise options for fiscal 2016 Acoustic Rapid Commercial Off-The-Shelf (COTS) Insertion (A-RCI) system engineering and technical support

proposals.announcement_evidence: for ship self-defense system combat system engineering support

proposals.announcement_evidence: for the purchase of missile tube long-lead-time material in support of the Columbia-class fleet ballistic missile submarines

proposals.rationale: Reject by design (rubric section 3, platform): the DDG 51 class is the ship class the planning yard serves. proposals.announcement_evidence: to exercise options for Acoustic - Rapid Commercial-Off-The-Shelf (COTS) Insertion (A-RCI) systems engineering and technical support
proposals.rationale: Third option year on the same A-RCI contract line, with the acronym spelled out again and the work described as the element's own: the contractor 'will perform engineering services to continue the development and production of COTS Insertion A-RCI Systems.' refute_b.reason: Third option year on the same contract and the same finding: the announcement spells the acronym out, 0604503N is the sole index owner of the A-RCI name, and the evidence is the program name rather than the contractor's - Lockheed Martin appears in the index nowhere as a program name.

proposals.announcement_evidence: This modification adds scope to procure 42 Maritime Strike Tomahawk Seeker (MST) suites for the Navy in support of MST Low Rate Production Three, to be installed into Tactical Tomahawk Missiles in the recertification effort
proposals.rationale: 'Maritime Strike Tomahawk Seeker (MST)' carries the index name 'Maritime Strike Tomahawk (MST)' with 'Seeker' inserted. MST is owned by two lines in this index - RDT&E element 0204229N and WPN line 2301, 'Tomahawk Mods' - and the announcement resolves the collision itself: this is Low Rate Production Three of seeker suites 'to be installed into Tactical Tomahawk Missiles in the recertification effort', i.e. a production kit inserted into fielded rounds, which is the definition of the Tomahawk modification line rather than of development. refute_b.reason: REFUTED on the alternative-owner ground: the exact string 'Maritime Strike Tomahawk (MST)' is owned by TWO PEs in this index - RDT&E element 0204229N (line 123, Tomahawk/TMPC) and WPN line 2301 (line 1399, Tomahawk Mods) - and nothing in the record breaks the tie, because the paragraph states no appropriation; worse, the evidence tilts the other way, since the award is a cost-plus-incentive-fee/cost-plus-fixed-fee modification to NAVAIR development contract N00019-19-C-0079 and the named article is the MST *Seeker*, the development element's own product, so the choice of 2301 over 0204229N rests on inference about what a Low Rate Production lot must be funded with rather than on the announcement's words.

proposals.rationale: Trident II (D5) is named and WPN line 1250 ('TRIDENT II Mods') is the obvious candidate, but the award buys 'systems engineering and integration support services and special studies' - engineering support, which rubric section 3 treats as generic unless it is the line's own article - and the announcement obligates nothing that identifies an appropriation. proposals.announcement_evidence: for the procurement of 114 Tomahawk Block IV All Up Round missiles for the Navy

refute_a.reason: One hundred percent of the obligation is fiscal 2018 research, development test and evaluation funding against RDT&E element 0604503N, for named Technical Insertion 18-20 A-RCI work - the element's own development build, not generic engineering support with no program named.

refute_b.reason: A different contract but the same unique name: A-RCI is owned only by 0604503N, Technical Insertion 18-20 is an increment of that same system, and the stated fiscal 2018 research, development test and evaluation funding matches the only PE that owns the name, so there is no second candidate to prefer.

proposals.announcement_evidence: AGM-88B high-speed anti-radiation missiles into 145 full-rate production Lot 5 advanced anti-radiation guided missile all-up-rounds and 12 captive air training missiles
proposals.rationale: The index row does carry 'AGM-88E Advanced Anti-Radiation Guided Missile (AARGM)', but it sits under WPN line 2327 whose title is AARGM-ER - the extended-range increment (AGM-88G), a different variant from the Lot 5 baseline AARGM all-up-rounds this 2016 award converts from AGM-88B seekers. But the scope is 'inspections, modifications and repairs' performed at Boeing's Jacksonville depot, and the announcement says 'No funds are being obligated at time of award. Funds will be obligated on individual orders as they are issued.' Depot inspection and repair is commonly O&M work, and O&M sustainment attached to an aircraft-modification procurement line is the exact failure mode the held-out study found; with no appropriation stated, the evidence does not clear it.

proposals.announcement_evidence: for procurement of long lead time material and advance construction activities in support of LPD 28, Amphibious Transport Dock Ship class
proposals.rationale: Wrong increment: LPD 28 is the last Flight I San Antonio-class hull, while SCN line 3010 funds LPD Flight II, which begins at LPD 30. The index carries no Flight I LPD construction line for this org - its other LPD names (LPD 17, LPD 18) sit on the OPN class-support-equipment line 0946 and on the LX(R) design element - so fiscal 2016 SCN long-lead material for LPD 28 has no line here to attach to.

proposals.announcement_evidence: for the manufacturing of Virginia Payload Module and South Dakota Insertion prototype materials in support of Virginia Class Submarines
proposals.rationale: 'Virginia Payload Module' is the index name 'VIRGINIA Payload Module (VPM)' apart from capitalisation, and the same SCN line 2013 separately owns 'Acoustic Superiority (AS)' - the programme the announcement's second article, the South Dakota Insertion, belongs to. Both articles named are therefore the line's own content rather than a platform it merely supports, and the action is a modification to the Virginia-class construction contract N00024-10-C-2118 manufacturing that material. The competing Virginia owners in the index are OPN class support equipment and the New Design SSN element, neither of which builds hull modules.

refute_a.reason: The only money obligated is fiscal 2016 research, development, test and evaluation (Navy) - $15,903,000 - for manufacturing prototype materials 'in support of Virginia Class Submarines', i.e. RDT&E development work attached to SCN shipbuilding line 2013; that is exactly the wrong-appropriation failure mode, and the prototype material belongs to a development element rather than to the construction line.

refute_b.reason: 'VIRGINIA Payload Module (VPM)' appears at 2013 only; the competing Virginia rows are 0604558N (New Design SSN - Secondary Propulsion Unit and 'Undersea Dominance Payload Integration', a payload-integration name distinct from the hull module), 0942 Virginia Class Support Equipment, 9021 VACL spares and the two Photonics Mast Variant rows, none of which owns the VPM name, and the second article named (South Dakota Insertion) maps to 'Acoustic Superiority (AS)' on the same 2013 line rather than to any rival PE.

proposals.announcement_evidence: to provide maintenance, operation, and management support services for the F/A-18 organizational level, intermediate level, and missile maintenance repair and storage facilities for the government of Kuwait
proposals.rationale: Two independent rejections. Rubric section 3 generic services: this is organisational- and intermediate-level maintenance and facility management, not an article of the F-18 Series modification line. And the money is foreign: 'Foreign Military Sales customer funds in the amount of $77,115,421 will be obligated at the time of award', for the government of Kuwait, so no U.S. aircraft-procurement line executes it.

proposals.announcement_evidence: to exercise an option for the procurement of additional AN/ARC-210 radios and ancillary equipment for various domestic and foreign military sales aircraft
proposals.rationale: The ARC-210 name is carried by this index only as a component of OPN line 4269, the Unmanned Carrier Aviation mission control system, where it is the radio inside the MD-5 ground control station. This award buys AN/ARC-210 radios 'for various domestic and foreign military sales aircraft' - a common-equipment buy across the fleet with no connection to the UCA mission control line. Linking a shared radio to whichever line happens to list it as a component is attribution by component name, which the rubric rejects.
